question: According to the Köppen type of climate, the code Af represents:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical Wet Climate.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical Wet Climate**

 
 
• **According to the Koppen type of climate, the code Af represents Tropical Wet Climate.**
 
• Only along the Equator can you find a tropical wet climate. All year long, direct sunshine reaches the ground along the equator. Because the land along the Equator never tilts away from direct sunlight, the tilt of the Earth that causes seasons has no effect here.
 
• **Rainfall** is common in this region, and **temperatures** are consistently warm.
 
• Only at the equator and typically within **25 degrees** of the equator can you find tropical wet.
 
• However, this climate is not present on all **equatorial land.** The climate of a region is also influenced by other elements, like **wind patterns.​**

• **Koppen Climate**

 
 
• The **Koppen climate** classification classifies climates into five major climate groups, with subgroups within each group determined by seasonal patterns of **temperature and precipitation. **
 
• In the **1966 Trewartha climatic** classification system, the Koppen climate classification system underwent additional modifications (revised in 1980).
 
• One of the complaints of the Koppen system, which led to the development of the **Trewartha system**, was the lack of a more detailed middle latitude climate zone (**the C climate group was too broad**).
